title: {Je veux que...} - Expressing Wishes
description: Say what you want OTHERS to do! '{Je veux que tu viennes}' (I want you to come), '{Je veux qu'il parte}' (I want him to leave). Essential for relationships and work.
can_do: Express what you want others to do (I want you to...)
Communicate desires about other people's actions

vocabulary.gloss: I'd like you to be there
I want us to go together

concepts.definition: Express what you want SOMEONE ELSE to do (not yourself!)
concepts.example: {Je veux manger} (I want to eat - {me}) → {Je veux que tu manges} (I want YOU to eat - you)

concepts.definition: More polite way to express wishes
concepts.example: {J'aimerais que tu viennes} (I'd like you to come)

items.situation: Tell your friend you want them to come to the party

mistakes.feedback: That's YOU coming! For THEM coming, use: je veux que tu viennes

items.situation: Say you want someone annoying to leave
Tell someone you want them to understand something important
Politely say you'd like someone to be there (softer!)
items.cue: I'd like you to be there

mistakes.feedback: Use '{sois}' not 'es': j'aimerais que tu sois là

items.situation: Suggest going together to your friend
items.cue: I want us to go together

items.situation: Say you want her to know something (sharing info)

mistakes.feedback: Use '{sache}' not 'sait': je veux qu'elle sache
